post_actions.failed.defaultMessage: {action, select, favourite {The favourite} boost {The boost} bookmark {The bookmark} vote {The vote} other {The reaction}} did not finish.
post_actions.failed.description: The notice at the bottom of the page when the reader's favourite, boost, bookmark or emoji reaction on a post (set or taken back), or their vote in a post's poll, got no answer from the server (the network), beside Try again. The post shows again what it showed before. action is which of them.

post_actions.retry.description: The action of the notice of a failed favourite, boost, bookmark, emoji reaction or vote: it sends the same change again.
